# Prother
> Curated search and discovery directory for AI products and tools, with honest pricing, verified specs, and direct side-by-side comparisons.

## Core Hubs
- [All AI Tools](https://prother.dev/tools): Browse the full curated catalog of AI tools
- [Compare Tools](https://prother.dev/compare): Side-by-side matrix of features, pricing, and ratings
- [Topics & Stacks](https://prother.dev/topics): Intent-based discovery hubs
- [Editorial Standards](https://prother.dev/about#standards): The six published quality standards required for directory indexing
- [Forums](https://prother.dev/forums): Community discussions, reviews, and tool feedback
- [Journal](https://prother.dev/journal): Editorial deep dives, analysis, and AI ecosystem guides
- [RSS Feed](https://prother.dev/api/rss): Real-time syndication feed of newly published articles and tool updates

## Taxonomy & Categories
- [AI Models](https://prother.dev/categories/ai-models): Foundation models, reasoning engines, and multimodal APIs
- [Conversational AI](https://prother.dev/categories/conversational-ai): Chatbots, AI assistants, and customer support agents
- [Generative Content](https://prother.dev/categories/generative-content): Image, audio, video, and design generation tools
- [NLP & Text](https://prother.dev/categories/nlp-text): Writing, summarization, translation, and text analysis
- [Computer Vision](https://prother.dev/categories/computer-vision): OCR, object detection, and spatial understanding
- [Data & Analytics](https://prother.dev/categories/data-analytics): Business intelligence, data querying, and predictive AI
- [Automation & Agents](https://prother.dev/categories/automation): Workflow automation, web scraping, and RPA
- [Developer Frameworks](https://prother.dev/categories/dev-platforms): Code editors, LLM orchestration, evaluation, and local serving

## Key Pairwise Comparisons
- [Cursor vs Windsurf](https://prother.dev/compare/cursor-vs-windsurf): Side-by-side comparison of AI code editors
- [ChatGPT vs Claude](https://prother.dev/compare/chatgpt-vs-claude): Frontier AI assistant comparison
- [ChatGPT vs DeepSeek](https://prother.dev/compare/chatgpt-vs-deepseek): DeepSeek vs OpenAI flagship showdown
- [Claude vs DeepSeek](https://prother.dev/compare/claude-vs-deepseek): DeepSeek vs Anthropic Claude showdown
- [ChatGPT vs Perplexity](https://prother.dev/compare/chatgpt-vs-perplexity): Search and conversational AI comparison
- [Groq vs vLLM](https://prother.dev/compare/groq-vs-vllm): Fast cloud inference vs open-source serving
- [LiteLLM vs OpenRouter](https://prother.dev/compare/litellm-vs-openrouter): Unified API proxy and routing comparison
- [Aider vs Cline](https://prother.dev/compare/aider-vs-cline): Terminal CLI agent vs VS Code autonomous agent
- [Ollama vs vLLM](https://prother.dev/compare/ollama-vs-vllm): Local model execution vs high-throughput production engine
- [Aider vs Cursor](https://prother.dev/compare/aider-vs-cursor): Git-integrated CLI agent vs full AI IDE
- [Cline vs Cursor](https://prother.dev/compare/cline-vs-cursor): Open-source VS Code agent extension vs standalone IDE
